facts.fact: Niger's national meteorological directorate (DMN) runs a live satellite imagery page serving EUMETView/Meteosat products (Natural Colour Enhanced RGB, GEO/LEO-blended precipitation rate, Dust RGB for dust-storm monitoring).

systems.owner: Direction de la Météorologie Nationale du Niger (DMN)

note: Document names the national meteorology directorate only as a trainee, and states nothing on satellite data.
Municipal tax platform; nothing on weather or satellite data.
No satellite data use or local government connection stated.

facts.fact: The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Niger among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
